create_gumbel_noise: create a function that generates Gumbel-distributed noise matching the shape and dtype of an input tensor
create_mask_by_random_topk: create a function that masks tokens by selecting top-k lowest confidence scores with temperature-based randomness
create_amused_scheduler: create an AmusedScheduler instance for masked token generation with a cosine or linear masking schedule
run_amused_scheduler_step: run a single denoising step on masked token samples using the AmusedScheduler step method
run_amused_scheduler_add_noise: add noise to token samples by randomly masking tokens according to a cosine or linear schedule
